mergedParams.userDescription: Smooth 3D text rotating slowly to reveal the message. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Smooth 3D Text Rotation with Typokinetic Effects

prompts.prompt: Create a cinematic 3D text rotation preset that mimics professional title sequences seen in film trailers. The text should rotate along the Y-axis with a slow, dramatic reveal, starting from a 90-degree angle where it's edge-on to the camera, then rotating to face forward. Apply a subtle depth-of-field effect where parts of the text blur as they move away from the focal point. The animation should feel weighty and important, like a monument being unveiled. Use a two-stage animation: first the rotation (0-70% of duration), then a subtle scale-up pulse (70-100%) to emphasize arrival. Add a soft glow that intensifies as the text completes its rotation, creating a 'coming into focus' feeling. Consider adding subtle particle effects or light streaks that follow the text's rotation path.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center' containing a TextAtom. Apply transform-style: preserve-3d and perspective: 1000px via containerProps.style. Use generic effects with rotateY animation from 90deg to 0deg with ease-out easing over 70% duration. Add scale effect from 1 to 1.05 back to 1 for pulse. Implement glow using text-shadow with increasing intensity (0px to 20px spread). Use opacity keyframes from 0.3 to 1. For depth effect, apply blur filter that animates from 2px to 0px. Consider using internal effect preset 'glow-pulse' for the final emphasis. Set will-change: transform for GPU optimization. If using caption data, apply word-level delays with stagger of 0.1s per word for sequential reveal during rotation.

prompts.prompt: Design a kinetic typography preset inspired by motion graphics where each character rotates independently in 3D space before settling into place. Think of it as a 'text assembly' animation where letters tumble through space like puzzle pieces finding their positions. Each character should have its own rotation timeline with randomized initial angles (X, Y, and Z axes) that resolve to 0. Create a cascading effect where letters animate in sequence from left to right, but with overlapping timings for fluidity. Add a subtle bounce effect when each letter lands in position, like magnets snapping into place. Include a secondary animation where the assembled text performs a gentle continuous rotation on the Y-axis (infinite loop at 0.5rpm) to maintain visual interest.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'flex flex-row items-center justify-center gap-0' containing multiple TextAtom components (one per character). Split text into individual characters programmatically. Each TextAtom gets 'inline-block' class and unique transform origin. Apply staggered generic effects per character with rotateX (random -180 to 180deg), rotateY (random -180 to 180deg), rotateZ (random -90 to 90deg) all animating to 0deg. Use spring easing for bounce effect. Stagger delay: index * 0.05s. After assembly (at 80% duration), apply continuous rotateY animation to parent BaseLayout using a secondary effect with linear easing and infinite loop. Add translateY effect for each character starting from random(-20px, 20px) to 0 for floating assembly feel. Performance: use transform3d() for hardware acceleration, limit to 20 characters max for smooth playback.

prompts.prompt: Build a sophisticated text reveal preset that simulates a holographic projection forming in 3D space. The text should materialize through a combination of rotation, opacity, and scan-line effects. Start with the text rotated 45 degrees on both X and Y axes, appearing as if viewed from above-right. As it rotates to face forward, apply horizontal scan lines that build the text progressively from bottom to top. Add chromatic aberration during the formation phase - split RGB channels slightly offset, converging as the text solidifies. Include flickering effects during materialization and a subtle continuous float animation post-reveal. The overall feel should be futuristic and high-tech, like UI elements in sci-fi films.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden' containing TextAtom with 'text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-t from-cyan-400 to-blue-500'. Apply rotateX: 45deg, rotateY: 45deg initially via containerProps.style with perspective: 800px. Use generic effects to animate to rotateX: 0, rotateY: 0 over 60% duration with ease-in-out. For scan lines, use ::before pseudo-element with linear-gradient and translateY animation from 100% to -100%. Chromatic aberration: use filter with multiple drop-shadow effects offset by 1-2px in red/cyan. Flicker effect: rapid opacity changes (1, 0.6, 1, 0.8, 1) over 0.5s using steps(5) easing. Post-reveal float: subtle translateY from 0 to -5px to 0 with 3s duration, infinite loop. Add 'mix-blend-mode: screen' for holographic look. Consider using waveform effects if audio is present to make flicker sync with beats.

prompts.prompt: Create a liquid metal text animation where words flow into existence through 3D rotation combined with morphing effects. The text should appear to be made of mercury or liquid chrome, starting as a thin vertical line that rotates and expands to reveal the message. Begin with scaleX at 0.1 and rotateY at 90 degrees, creating an edge-on view. As it rotates to face forward, simultaneously expand scaleX to 1.0. Add a ripple effect that travels through the text during rotation, as if the metal is still settling. Include reflective properties with animated gradients that shift based on the rotation angle. The animation should feel fluid and organic, not mechanical, with subtle overshoot on the rotation for a more natural motion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with TextAtom using 'font-black tracking-tight'. Apply metallic gradient via 'bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-300 via-gray-400 to-gray-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent'. Initial state: scaleX: 0.1, rotateY: 90deg via effects. Animate to scaleX: 1, rotateY: 0 over 70% duration with custom cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) for overshoot. Ripple effect: use filter with custom SVG turbulence that animates baseFrequency from 0.02 to 0. Add secondary gradient animation changing angle from 45deg to 225deg to simulate reflection changes. Include subtle scaleY oscillation (1 to 1.02 to 1) during rotation for liquid feel. Performance: use transform-origin: center, will-change: transform, and GPU-accelerated properties only. If using caption data, apply per-word timing with 0.15s overlap for flowing sentence reveal.

prompts.prompt: Develop a documentary-style lower third preset where text rotates up from below the baseline with depth and sophistication. Inspired by news graphics and documentary titles, the text should rotate on the X-axis as if hinged at the bottom, swinging up from a -90 degree position lying flat. Add a subtle blur that decreases as the text rises, simulating depth of field. Include a supporting line or bar element that slides in first to establish the space, then the text rotates up from it. The animation should be professional and understated, with precise timing that feels broadcast-quality. Add a subtle shadow that grows as the text stands up, grounding it in the space.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'absolute bottom-20 left-10' containing two child BaseLayouts. First child: rectangular bar with 'h-1 bg-white' that uses scaleX from 0 to 1 (width animation). Second child: TextAtom with 'text-4xl font-bold' positioned above bar. Set transform-origin: bottom for text rotation. Initial rotateX: -90deg, animate to 0deg over 60% duration with ease-out. Blur effect: filter from blur(4px) to blur(0px). Shadow: use drop-shadow starting at 0px growing to 10px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3). Bar animation completes at 30% duration, text rotation starts at 20% for overlap. Add subtle opacity fade from 0.7 to 1. Consider fitDurationTo: 'children' for automatic timing. If typography preset, use caption data for word-level stagger with 0.08s delays.

prompts.prompt: Design an orbital text animation where words rotate around an invisible sphere before settling into readable position. Picture text traveling along a 3D arc path, as if attached to a spinning globe. Start with the text positioned behind the viewer (rotateY: 180deg) and slightly above (translateY: -50px). The text follows a curved trajectory, rotating through 3D space while gradually descending to center position. Add a trailing motion blur effect during the fastest part of the rotation, and implement a zoom effect where text scales from 0.7 to 1.2 then settles at 1.0. The movement should feel planetary and smooth, like observing celestial bodies. Include a subtle continuous drift after the main animation completes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'flex items-center justify-center h-screen' containing TextAtom. Use transform-style: preserve-3d and perspective: 1200px. Create orbital path using combined transforms: rotateY from 180deg to 0deg, translateZ from -200px to 0px (depth), translateY from -50px to 0px (height). Scale animation: 0.7 to 1.2 (at 60%) to 1.0 (ease-in-out). Motion blur: apply filter blur from 0 to 3px back to 0, peaking at 40% duration when rotation is fastest. Use cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for smooth deceleration. Post-animation drift: subtle rotateY from 0 to 5deg to 0deg, 4s duration, infinite. Add 'backface-visibility: hidden' for clean rotation. Optional: use multiple TextAtoms with staggered delays for multi-line text orbiting at different speeds/distances.

prompts.prompt: Create a glitch-inspired 3D text rotation where the typography appears to be breaking through digital interference. The text rotates in 3D space but with intentional 'errors' - sudden jumps in rotation angle, brief moments where the text splits into RGB channels, and occasional position shifts. Start with rapid micro-rotations on all axes (like tuning into a signal), then stabilize into a smooth Y-axis rotation from -45deg to 0deg. During rotation, add datamosh-style artifacts where parts of the text appear to lag behind. Include scan lines and static noise overlays that intensify during glitch moments. The overall effect should feel like corrupted data reconstructing itself into legible form.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with position relative, containing three TextAtom layers for RGB split effect. Main text: 'text-white', R channel: 'text-red-500 absolute', G channel: 'text-green-500 absolute', B channel: 'text-blue-500 absolute'. Initial state: random micro-rotations using steps(3) easing for first 20% duration. Main rotation: rotateY from -45deg to 0deg, but with steps(8) easing for stuttered motion. RGB split: translateX offsets of -2px, 0px, 2px that converge to 0px. Glitch moments: at 30%, 50%, 70% duration, apply rapid position changes using translateX/Y with random values ±10px for 0.1s. Scan lines: ::after element with repeating-linear-gradient, opacity pulsing. Static: use CSS filter with SVG feTurbulence, animate seed value. Add 'mix-blend-mode: difference' during glitches. Performance: limit glitch effects to 3 instances to prevent jank.

prompts.prompt: Build a paper-folding origami-style text animation where words appear to unfold from a flat plane into 3D space. Visualize the text as if printed on paper that's been folded multiple times, now unfolding to reveal the message. Start with extreme scaleY compression (0.05) and multiple rotation angles, as if viewing the edge of folded paper. The unfolding should happen in segments - first rotateX straightens, then rotateY, then scaleY expands, creating a sequential reveal. Add subtle paper texture and shadows between 'folds' that disappear as the text flattens. Include a slight paper flutter effect at the end, as if the text is settling after unfolding.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout containing multiple BaseLayout 'segments' (split text into 2-3 parts for fold lines). Each segment is a TextAtom with 'relative' positioning. Initial state per segment: scaleY: 0.05, rotateX: -85deg, rotateY: alternating 45deg/-45deg. Animation sequence: Phase 1 (0-33%): rotateX to 0deg, Phase 2 (25-66%): rotateY to 0deg with overlap, Phase 3 (50-100%): scaleY to 1. Add 'transform-origin: left center' for left segment, 'right center' for right segment. Paper texture: subtle 'bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-50 to-white' with 0.95 opacity. Shadows: use box-shadow with inset shadows that fade from 10px to 0px. Flutter: post-animation rotateX oscillation ±2deg with spring easing. Add 'preserve-3d' and perspective: 800px. Consider using sub-presets for each fold segment if text is long.

prompts.prompt: Design a volumetric text preset where words appear to have physical depth and rotate through a fog-like environment. The text should feel three-dimensional and substantial, rotating slowly on Y-axis from -60deg to 0deg while emerging from atmospheric haze. Apply a depth-based fog effect where distant parts of the text during rotation appear lighter and less defined. Include volumetric lighting effects - imagine stage lights hitting the text from specific angles, creating dramatic highlights and shadows that shift during rotation. Add floating particles or dust motes that help sell the sense of depth and atmosphere. The animation should feel cinematic and moody, like a title reveal in a thriller film.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative bg-gradient-radial from-gray-900 to-black' containing TextAtom with 'text-8xl font-black'. Apply text-shadow with multiple layers for depth: '3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 6px 6px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 9px 9px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'. RotateY animation from -60deg to 0deg over 80% duration with ease-out. Fog effect: overlay div with 'absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-gray-100/20 to-transparent' that fades opacity from 0.8 to 0.2. Volumetric lighting: use conic-gradient background on text (via bg-clip-text) that rotates counter to text rotation. Particles: absolute positioned divs with 'rounded-full bg-white/30' using random positions and opacity animations. Add subtle scaleZ: 1.2 for depth enhancement. Use 'perspective: 1500px' for deeper field. Performance: limit particles to 10, use transform3d() for all animations.

prompts.prompt: Create a helix-style DNA rotation where text spirals into view along a helical path. The typography should appear to be wrapped around an invisible cylinder, rotating into the camera's view while also traveling along a vertical axis. Start with text at the top of the spiral, rotated away, then have it corkscrew down while rotating to face forward. Add a secondary twist effect where individual characters within the text also have slight rotation offsets, creating a ribbon-like appearance. Include trailing light streams that follow the spiral path, and implement a subtle color shift from cool to warm tones as the text completes its journey. The effect should feel organic and flowing, like genetic code materializing.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative h-full' containing TextAtom. Use transform-origin: center center with perspective: 1000px. Helical path: combine rotateY from 360deg to 0deg with translateY from -100px to 0px and translateZ using sin/cos functions for circular depth. Create path using keyframes at 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% with calculated positions. Per-character twist: if using caption data, apply rotateZ offset of index * 5deg to each word, animating to 0deg. Light streams: use ::before and ::after with 'absolute h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-cyan-400 to-transparent' following the same path with delay. Color shift: animate color from rgb(100,200,255) to rgb(255,200,100) over duration. Use cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) for smooth spiral motion. Add 'will-change: transform' and limit spiral to 1 full rotation for performance. Consider waveform effects to modulate rotation speed based on audio intensity if available.
